title: Graph Disjointness with Applications to Reversible Markov Chains
summary: The correspondence between weighted undirected graphs and reversible Markov chains via vertex random walks is simple and well known. Leveraging this correspondence and ideas from the theory of dynamical systems, we study the structural discordance of graphs and Markov chains by means of graph joinings. Informally, a joining of graphs $G$ and $H$ is a graph on the product of their vertex sets giving rise to a coupling of their random walks.
